status: pre-analysis gate, no historical cohort constructed
purpose: Define technical eligibility checks before downloading or analysing a multiyear GWIS cohort.
primary_geography: Tolima, defined by the existing Cortolima municipal boundary union

candidate_regional_context_rule.definition: First-order administrative neighbours that share a nonzero boundary segment with Tolima in geoBoundaries COL ADM1.
candidate_regional_context_rule.interpretation_limit: Adjacency creates a deterministic context set. It does not establish environmental comparability or authorize pooled inference.

gwis_temporal_follow_up.required_query_window: August 1 through September 15 for every completed historic season
gwis_temporal_follow_up.reason: Detect whether August-only requests truncate final dates and define a common observation window.
gwis_temporal_follow_up.current_2026_status: not eligible for this test until September 15 has passed and the service response is audited

pre_execution_protocol.event_identifier: fire_id, with id only when fire_id is absent
pre_execution_protocol.target_event_reconstruction: deduplicate tiled geometries then retain only events intersecting the Tolima boundary union
required_diagnostics: all August-probe Tolima events reappear in the follow-up request
initial and final dates are compared as returned strings
follow-up events beginning after August are counted but never added to the August event set
events ending after September 15 are counted before any later cohort decision
pre_execution_protocol.interpretation_limit: The audit tests request-window stability and right-censoring risk. It does not establish event completeness, equal detection sensitivity, or authorise multiyear modelling.

era5_land.precipitation: blocked pending correct interpretation of accumulated GRIB values

independent_or_partially_independent_mea.required_before_validation_claim: download, inspect raster layers and quality flags, then specify spatial and temporal agreement criteria before comparison
independent_or_partially_independent_mea.current_status: catalogue availability only for 2018 to 2025, no suitable August 2026 granule in CMR

prohibited_actions: Mix FIRMS Standard Processing historical detections with August 2026 NRT detections as one homogeneous series.
Treat GWIS or FIRMS detections as independent validation of one another.
Use an August-only request as proof of final event duration without a common follow-up audit.
Pool neighbouring departments or call them comparable before an explicit comparability assessment.
Use precipitation before the ERA5 accumulation diagnostic is resolved.
decision_rule: Only after every required technical check is documented may the investigator review a proposed cohort definition and decide whether to authorise multiyear descriptive or associational analysis.
